objective.text: Keep plaintext query assumptions separate from encrypted attribute storage.

difficulty.rationale: Separate model decryption from database equality semantics and account for a deliberate search design.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A support tool stores notes through an encrypted cast. It tries where("notes", $plaintext)->first() to locate an exact note, but stored ciphertext is randomized. Which design statement is accurate?

options.text: Eloquent decrypts every notes column inside SQL before applying the where clause.
options.rationale: The application-level cast does not install a database decryption expression.
options.misconception: The application-level cast does not install a database decryption expression.

options.text: The cast does not make plaintext SQL equality work; searchable sensitive data needs a separately designed lookup strategy.
options.rationale: Casting decrypts retrieved model attributes. It does not rewrite a plaintext WHERE value into a useful match for randomized ciphertext.

options.text: Encrypt the input once and equality will always match independently encrypted identical notes.
options.rationale: Randomized encryption can produce different ciphertext for the same plaintext.
options.misconception: Randomized encryption can produce different ciphertext for the same plaintext.

options.text: Add notes to $fillable so the query builder applies its encrypted cast to predicates.
options.rationale: Mass-assignment permission does not transform database comparison semantics.
options.misconception: Mass-assignment permission does not transform database comparison semantics.
